title: Tax Track, Lesson 5: The 2026 reform - from 7 bands to 5, and who gains
subtitle: Comparing the tax bill before and after the reform
whyItMatters: This is the biggest change to Vietnamese income tax in over a decade, in force from the 2026 tax year. If you have not recalculated your net salary under the new rules, your personal budget is running on old numbers.
openingQuestion: What does the income tax reform, in force from the 2026 tax year, actually change?
openingOptions: Only the personal deduction rises; the scale stays at 7 bands
Only the number of bands falls from 7 to 5; the deductions stay put
It cuts 7 bands to 5, raises the personal deduction, and lowers the middle rates
It moves to a flat 10% rate at every level of income
explanation: The reform makes three changes at once: (1) the scale drops from 7 bands to 5, with wider gaps between them; (2) the band 2 rate falls from 15% to 10% and band 3 from 25% to 20%; (3) the family circumstance deduction rises from 11 to 15.5 million (yourself) and from 4.4 to 6.2 million (per dependant). All three point the same way - a lighter tax burden.

realWorldExample.description: Under the old rules: taxable income = 30 − 3.15 − 11 = 15.85 million, tax due about 1,627,500 VND a month. Under the 2026 rules: taxable income = 30 − 3.15 − 15.5 = 11.35 million, tax of only 635,000 VND a month. That saves nearly 993,000 VND every month, or about 11.9 million VND a year.

quiz.question: How does the band 2 rate change under the reform?
options: It falls from 10% to 5%
It falls from 15% to 10%
It rises from 10% to 15%
It stays at 15%, as before
quiz.explanation: Band 2 falls from 15% to 10%, and band 3 from 25% to 20% - the two bands most salaried people fall into.

quiz.question: Which group gains most clearly from this reform?
options: The lowest earners, who are exempt from tax entirely from 2026
The highest earners, because the threshold for the very top rate has been raised
Middle earners, who get both a higher deduction and lower rates
Everyone gains equally, because the cut is applied uniformly
quiz.explanation: Middle earners gain twice over: the higher deduction pulls taxable income down, and what remains is taxed at lower rates in the middle bands.

quiz.question: How does the threshold for the top 35% rate change?
options: The 35% band is removed from the new scale entirely from 2026
It falls from 80 million to 60 million VND a month
It stays at 80 million VND a month
It rises from 80 million to 100 million VND a month
quiz.explanation: The threshold for the 35% rate rises from above 80 million to above 100 million VND of taxable income a month.

quiz.question: Beyond cutting tax, what does going from 7 bands to 5 achieve?
options: A simpler scale, with less band-jumping as pay rises
Taxpayers no longer have to file a year-end reconciliation
Companies no longer have to withhold tax at source
Investment income now falls under the same scale
quiz.explanation: Fewer bands with wider gaps make the calculation simpler, and a modest pay rise is less likely to push you into a higher band.

quiz.question: Of the three changes in the 2026 reform, which matters most to a middle earner?
options: Cutting the scale from seven bands to five, because the calculation gets simpler
Raising the family circumstance deduction, because it comes straight off taxable income
Raising the top-rate threshold, because it lightens the burden in the highest band
Widening the gaps between bands, because rising pay moves you up more slowly
quiz.explanation: The deduction acts at the root: it cuts the income that ever enters the scale, so it helps even someone sitting only in the first band. A change to the top threshold is only reached by high earners.

keyTakeaways: The 2026 scale: 5 bands (5/10/20/30/35%) at 10 - 30 - 60 - 100 million, replacing the old 7
The family circumstance deduction rises: 11→15.5 million for yourself, 4.4→6.2 million per dependant
A single person on 30 million saves about 993,000 VND a month against the old rules

practicePrompt.question: Hung earns 45 million gross and is single. Under the 2026 rules, what is his monthly income tax? (Insurance 10.5%)
options: About 4.5 million VND
About 1.98 million VND
About 2.52 million VND
About 900,000 VND
practicePrompt.explanation: Insurance = 45 × 10.5% = 4.725 million. Taxable income = 45 − 4.725 − 15.5 = 24.775 million. Sliced by band: 10 million × 5% = 500,000 VND; the part from 10 to 24.775 million (that is, 14.775 million) × 10% = 1,477,500 VND. Total tax = 1,977,500 VND, about 1.98 million. Worth noting: the effective rate is only about 4.4% of gross salary, even though Hung is 'in the 10% band'.

summary.keyIdea: The 2026 reform cuts the number of bands, lowers the middle rates and raises the deduction - all three reduce tax
summary.commonMistake: Still calculating net salary on the old 11 million deduction, and so misjudging take-home pay.
summary.action: Recalculate your net salary on the 2026 scale and deduction.

application.title: Rebuild your budget on the new rates
application.message: If you built your budget before 2026, work out your net salary again on the 15.5 million deduction and the 5-band scale. The difference can go towards a higher savings rate rather than quietly disappearing into spending.
application.secondary: Tax rules change over time - check again at the start of each financial year.

sections.text: From the 2026 tax year, Vietnamese personal income tax moves in the taxpayer's favour on all three fronts at once: fewer bands, lower rates in the middle, and a considerably larger deduction.
Three changes at the same time

items: The scale drops from 7 bands to 5, with wider gaps between them (Article 9, Law 109/2025/QH15)
The band 2 rate falls from 15% to 10%; band 3 falls from 25% to 20%
The threshold for the top 35% rate rises from above 80 million to above 100 million VND a month
The family circumstance deduction rises by nearly 41%: 11 → 15.5 million for yourself, 4.4 → 6.2 million per dependant (Resolution 110/2025/UBTVQH15)

sections.title: Someone on 30 million gross, single
sections.equation: Saving = Tax under the old rules − Tax under the 2026 rules

example.title: Before and after the reform
example.result: Saving ≈ 992,500 VND a month, about 11.9 million VND a year
example.explanation: The gain comes from both sides: the higher deduction pulls taxable income down by 4.5 million, and what remains is taxed more lightly now that band 2 has fallen from 15% to 10%.

sections.label: On when it applies
sections.text: The 2025 Personal Income Tax Law takes effect on 1 July 2026, but the provisions on income from wages and salaries and on the family circumstance deduction apply from the 2026 tax year - that is, across the whole of 2026. The difference for the early months is settled at the year-end reconciliation.

left.label: The old scale - 7 bands
left.text: Thresholds at 5 - 10 - 18 - 32 - 52 - 80 million, rates of 5/10/15/20/25/30/35%. Narrow bands, so pay rises crossed them easily.

right.label: The 2026 scale - 5 bands
right.text: Thresholds at 10 - 30 - 60 - 100 million, rates of 5/10/20/30/35%. Wider, simpler, and lower tax across the common income range.

lines: The 2026 reform cuts tax most clearly for middle earners.
